atoms.a: Ben, Rahim, Emma and Judy share a pizza. They cut it into equal parts. How many parts are there?

correct.text: They get one quarter of the pizza each.

atoms.a: Josephine cuts a cake into four equal pieces. How is the cake divided?

correct.text: The cake is divided into quarters.

atoms.a: Four friends share a pie equally. What size piece does everybody get?

correct.text: Everybody gets one quarter of the pie.

atoms.a: Jimmy shares his sandwich with his three best friends. How many equal parts does Jimmy have to cut his sandwich into?

correct.text: Jimmy has to cut the sandwich into four quarters.
